notes: Plan 7 Track C: the four grades of combat design §4 (AC and DEX cap in ARMOUR_AC; plate is AC 16 flat and gives disadvantage on Stealth for surprise). Prices are gp at an armourer, near 5e (plate is cheaper than 5e's 1500 gp: a goal, not a dream); weights are kg on the carrying scale (20 kg a member at STR 10), lighter than 5e so armour does not crowd out cargo. Class proficiencies are CLASS_PROFICIENCIES: untrained armour puts the wearer's attacks at disadvantage.
